title: UE Render Debug Capture
description: Capture render debug views, observe Niagara particle attributes through public SimCache APIs, inspect loaded runtime objects, and analyze retained rendering failure logs offline.

recipes.title: Analyze retained rendering failure evidence
recipes.description: Read explicit finalized log and CrashContext paths locally, retaining bounded source evidence without requiring an Editor connection.

inputs.name: projectRoot
inputs.description: Absolute directory containing the retained diagnostic files.

inputs.name: files
inputs.description: One to eight explicit paths relative to projectRoot.

steps.purpose: Load the local operation schema and select finalized artifacts with explicit bounds.
Execute once through localProject; no Editor connection is needed.
Inspect the returned ranges, hashes and truncation flags. Keep each source independent and the root cause unproven; do not re-execute just to verify the response.

result.summary: Bounded DRED, device-removal, resource and queue evidence with exact source ranges.
success: metadata-only dumps are not described as decoded
active breadcrumbs and nearby resources are not treated as root causes

recipes.title: Inspect loaded Niagara runtime objects
recipes.description: Read bounded world, component and AsyncGpuTrace Data Interface inventory through existing Niagara APIs, without an engine patch or GPU readback.

inputs.name: world
inputs.description: Optional exact loaded Editor or PIE world path; omit to discover worlds.

inputs.name: offset
inputs.description: Zero-based offset for each independently paged object array.

inputs.name: limit
inputs.description: Maximum rows per object array, from 1 to 128.

steps.purpose: Load the inventory schema and select an optional exact world; no GPU capture or PIE restart is required.
Read the loaded worlds, components and Data Interfaces with explicit pagination.
Check returned world identities, pagination and loaded-object scope; configured values do not establish GPU execution. Do not re-execute solely to verify the response.

result.summary: Bounded loaded-object inventory and configured provider values without engine modifications.
evidence: Data Interface path and configured provider enum
success: requested world is not silently substituted
component and DI arrays respect their page bounds
loaded objects and configured values are not described as GPU dispatch or collision evidence

recipes.title: Observe bounded Niagara SimCache attributes
recipes.description: Capture explicit attributes without engine changes; inspect frame layouts, page values, export evidence and release transient storage.

inputs.name: world
inputs.description: Exact loaded Editor or PIE world from inventory.

inputs.name: attributes
inputs.description: 1-32 qualified compiled attributes, e.g. the discovered emitter prefix plus Position.

steps.purpose: Read live schemas and inventory; select the exact component and qualified attributes. GPU capture can stall.
Capture once with explicit frames/rate/timeout. No automatic simulation advance, activation or PIE restart.
Require retained=true and inspect complete/partial/failed, reason, frame count and captured layouts. Read exact frames and attributes; preserve pagination and raw-coordinate semantics.
Export selected pages with source metadata and SHA-256 when persistent evidence is needed; this is not a full replay asset.
Release transient storage after inspection/export; four recordings may be retained per Editor instance.

result.summary: Recorded particle/system attribute evidence with explicit completion, shape and paging limits.
evidence: recorded emitter layouts and per-frame counts
success: required frames are complete or explicitly partial
attribute names come from the recorded layout
no private GPU Trace evidence is inferred

recipes.title: Capture and compare one rendering debug view
recipes.description: Resolve a live visualization mode, capture one exact viewport with restoration evidence, analyze it, and compare it with a compatible baseline when supplied.

inputs.name: target
inputs.description: Exact Editor Level Viewport or PIE session and generation target.

inputs.name: mode
inputs.description: Visualization mode ID returned by live mode discovery.

inputs.name: baselineCaptureId
inputs.description: Compatible persisted capture used for an optional pixel comparison.

steps.purpose: Resolve live mode availability from the current Engine, RHI, optional modules, and exact viewport target.
Temporarily apply the selected mode, capture only the exact viewport, and restore the original view state on every exit path.
Read bounded mode-aware pixel, luminance, coverage, histogram, and regional evidence from the persisted capture.
When a baseline exists, verify render-fingerprint compatibility and produce bounded changed-pixel and diff-image evidence.

result.summary: Exact viewport debug-view evidence with restoration, bounded analysis, and optional compatible visual diff.
evidence: target viewport and PIE generation identity
lossless capture ID, image hash, and render fingerprint
comparison compatibility, changed-pixel ratio, and diff capture ID
success: the selected mode was reported available for the exact target
the capture came from the requested viewport rather than a desktop or unrelated window
original view mode, flags, camera, exposure, selection, and transform were restored
analysis remained bounded and did not claim raw GBuffer or RDG texture values
incompatible fingerprints produced an inconclusive comparison

resources.description: Niagara loaded-object inspection and offline render failure contracts, existing engine APIs and verification limits.
Visualization availability, viewport targeting, state restoration, image-format, and analysis boundaries.
